C1.worst_defect: The home page never says which counter device works. The only hint is "Its browser tests run in desktop Chrome", so an owner with a counter tablet or iPad can't tell whether their staff can sell on it tomorrow. The opening line also leans on developer jargon ("Vendure, the open-source headless commerce framework").

C2.worst_defect: Very honest overall: the offline test and the 200-send test are linked, and the limitations page is plain. The one gap is that the home "What it does today" cards lead with what works, and the refund gap shows only as one table row, "No, not on plugin 0.3.0".
C2.where: home.desktop.02 "Live demo or your own store" table

C3.worst_defect: The developer path is thorough and has success checks. But for the owner, a return can't be finished without the developer: "the till cannot refund. Ask whoever manages your Vendure store to refund the order in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund then shows as Pending until they settle it", and settling needs a GraphQL settleRefund mutation.
C3.where: at-the-till.desktop.02 "Refund a sale"; plugin-setup "Settle a Dashboard refund"

C4.worst_defect: The cashier guide mixes a "Refund at the till (live demo)" subsection into the real-store steps, which will confuse staff. Troubleshooting's "For the store owner: copy the refused line… match its errorCode" and "Resolve a sale the store kept part-way" are written for a developer, not an owner.

C5.worst_defect: No real defect. The 404 page leaves a large empty area below its three buttons.

C6.worst_defect: The pages stack well, but At the till, the page staff need most, runs to 9 phone slices (about 9,200 px). "If the internet drops" and "Count the drawer and close the day" sit far down, and the only shortcut is the collapsed "On this page" dropdown.

C7.worst_defect: Strong: every page returns 200, Lighthouse mobile scores 98/100/100/100 with CLS 0, JSON-LD is present, and llms.txt and search work. The one nit is that home ships 52 KiB of unused JavaScript.

overall_worst.defect: On plugin 0.3.0 a shop owner cannot finish a customer return. "the till cannot refund. Ask whoever manages your Vendure store to refund the order in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund then shows as Pending until they settle it", and settling needs a GraphQL settleRefund mutation in GraphiQL. Every return needs the developer, and the cashier page never gives staff a plain counter procedure.
overall_worst.where: at-the-till.desktop.02 "Refund a sale"; limitations; plugin-setup "Settle a Dashboard refund"
overall_worst.fix: Put a short owner-facing "Returns on plugin 0.3.0" box at the top of the At the till refunds section. It should say what staff do at the counter right now (give the money back, note the order code), who settles the refund, and link the developer steps. Move "Refund at the till (live demo)" off the cashier page, or label it clearly as demo-only.
